scope: Named original evidence sources and explicit identification limits; not original article microdata or a finding of an actual hostile operation.
original_source_credit: Original communications were produced by their credited authors/organisations; historical and empirical analyses remain credited to their researchers. DASHI owns the formal tests and provenance graph only.

cases.subject: GCC/E. Bruce Harrison agency media activities 1993–1995
cautions: Agency-authored impact claims are not externally measured changes
GCC actions may not be attributed to the distinct April 1998 API proposal

cases.subject: GCC-held 1993 media clipping archive
cautions: Archived clippings are not a representative outlet sample
A media appearance is not proof of audience persuasion

cases.subject: GCC 1993 response to Clinton Earth Day pledge: contemporaneous letter addressed to reporters with news release and two articles
cautions: Original letter is evidence of a written reporter-directed communication, not independent proof a given reporter received or was persuaded by it
Original archive summary is not a digest-verified transcription of scanned original letter
Article attachments are distinct third-party authored objects and not GCC-authored publications
The source predates the separate April 1998 API proposal

cases.subject: April 1998 API Global Climate Science Communications Team plan
cautions: The documented draft is not evidence of implementation or endorsement by every named participant

cases.subject: 1977–2014 ExxonMobil communications: 187-document published analysis
cautions: The original 187-document cohort and 26 relevant advertorial denominator must not be fused with the expanded 2020 corpus
Comparative document coding is not an audience treatment effect

cases.subject: Léon distinct theatrical/extended versions and situated cinematic interpretations
cautions: Edition metadata is not source-authenticated footage
Interpretations of gaze or milk-spitting are not author intent or observed audience response

cases.subject: Don't Look Up fictional satire
cautions: Fiction is not an observation of a historical influence operation

cases.subject: Planet of the Humans documentary argument
cautions: Original documentary assertions need proposition-specific independent testing
No automatic audience-response or operations attribution

discriminator_requirements.question: Did target people/institutions encounter specified original intervention?
discriminator_requirements.necessary: dated distribution plus independently attributable exposure record

discriminator_requirements.question: Did scrutinising evidence, responsibility frames, trust, agency or revision response change?
discriminator_requirements.necessary: original coded baseline, reproducible blinded coding, independent reviewer disagreement and uncertainty

discriminator_requirements.question: Could common issue attention, prior trends, ordinary persuasion or contemporaneous events explain the difference?
discriminator_requirements.necessary: matched observational design or ethically permitted controlled exposure, negative controls and sensitivity analysis

discriminator_requirements.question: What independent historical documents support intention, coordination and targeting of a hostile operation?
discriminator_requirements.necessary: actor-origin primary records and independently checked chronology, not retrospective inferred motive

claim: No named case currently has the full independently validated operation-identification chain in this repository.
excluded_inferences: Message content does not prove population belief change
Public agreement does not prove evidence-responsive revision
Effect does not establish hostile purpose
Institutional contact does not prove draft uptake
Artwork does not certify historical cognition or audience manipulation
